title: rubus vulgaris subsp. commutatus
intro: Rubus vulgaris subsp. commutatus, commonly known as American black raspberry, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its rich content of anthocyanins, vitamins, and minerals, which provide various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of American black raspberry are attributed to its ability to protect against cell damage, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
